  • Method Details

    • registerLayout

      public static boolean registerLayout(String type, Function<String,LayoutBuilder> builderFactory)
      Registers a new layout type with the system.
      Parameters:
      type - The unique name of the layout to be registered. This string serves as the identifier for the layout type.
      builderFactory - A factory function that creates instances of LayoutBuilder for the specified layout type. The factory function takes the layout type as input and returns the corresponding LayoutBuilder.
      Returns:
      true if the layout type was successfully registered, or false if a layout with the same name had already been registered.

    • getRegisteredLayouts

      public static final Map<String,Function<String,LayoutBuilder>> getRegisteredLayouts()
      Retrieves an unmodifiable view of all registered layouts and their corresponding builder factories. The returned map associates layout names with functions capable of constructing instances of LayoutBuilder.
      Returns:
      a map where the keys are layout names (as String) and the values are functions that take a String and return a LayoutBuilder instance.

    • getBuilder

      public static Optional<Function<String,LayoutBuilder>> getBuilder(String name)
      Retrieves the builder function associated with the specified layout name. The builder function is a Function that accepts a String argument and returns a LayoutBuilder instance. If no builder is registered for the given name, an empty Optional is returned.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the layout for which the builder function is requested.
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the builder function if found, or an empty Optional if no builder is associated with the given name.

    • builder

      public static Function<String,LayoutBuilder> builder(String name)
      Retrieves the builder function associated with the specified layout name. If the layout name has not been registered, an IllegalStateException is thrown to indicate that the layout is unsupported.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the layout whose builder function is to be retrieved
      Returns:
      a Function that takes a String and returns a LayoutBuilder, which can be used to construct the desired layout
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no builder function is associated with the specified layout name
